request.objective: Start at https://us.megabus.com/. Find out what to do when I lose an item on a bus on us.megabus.

response.result: If you lost an item on a Megabus bus, report it to Megabus Lost and Found using the linked form in the FAQ. Submit the necessary information about the item so the inquiry can be processed. Lost and Found responds to all inquiries, but the investigation may take several days. Megabus says it will make every attempt to return lost items and help with retrieval to the best of its ability.
